soi6-040.name: Wicked Bar

opening_hours.note: Recent Wicked social posts advertise opening from 4 PM until 2 AM. A specialist listing updated 28 Aug 2026 gives 14:00–02:00, while another active Wicked account has advertised selected 17:00–03:00 sessions. Treat hours as variable and verify on the day.

soi6-040.description: Long-running Soi 6 hostess bar near the Beach Road half of the street. Wicked replaced the former Viking Bar identity in 2017 and received a fresh operational relaunch under new management in May 2025.
soi6-040.vibe: High-energy party-bar atmosphere with loud music and an active hostess lineup; recent official posts emphasize cold drinks, music and a lively party environment.
soi6-040.drinks: Fully stocked bar; alcoholic beverages confirmed.
soi6-040.seating_style: Bar seating; some secondary sources describe counter and sofa seating, but exact current layout is not independently confirmed.
soi6-040.review_summary: Recent specialist/community material generally describes Wicked as an established mainstream Soi 6 option with a lively party atmosphere. Published subjective ratings vary and are not treated as verified quality metrics.
soi6-040.community_notes: A 2025 Pattaya forum contributor reported using Wicked's short-time facilities and described the room itself as basic. This is an individual anecdote, not a verified facility review.
